item.title: £40bn People’s Pension revises climate strategy
item.description: People’s Pension has enacted an updated climate approach, aiming to align its investment strategy more closely with real-world developments and long-term member outcomes.

item.title: 2025 saw a rise of 700GW in renewables
item.description: 2025 saw total renewable power capacity reach 5,149GW after the addition of 692 GW, or a 15.5 per cent of annual increase, according to new report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA).

item.title: £64m for Port Talbot offshore wind hub
item.description: Port Talbot’s development as the first port in the Celtic Sea specifically developed to support floating offshore wind (FLOW) has received Government backing of ‘up to’ £64m, subject to final clearance by the Competition and Markets Authority.

item.title: Church moves against bank backtracking
item.description: The Church of England Pensions Board has said that it will vote against the reappointment of directors at banks that have materially backtracked on their climate commitments during the current AGM season.

item.title: Crown Estate revises Leasing Round 6
item.description: The Crown Estate has announced a new process ahead of an intended official launch of a new leasing round, Offshore Wind Leasing Round 6, in the first half of 2027.

item.title: BSI issues anti- greenwashing guidance
item.description: The BSI (British Standards Institute) has published guidelines for fund managers designed to strengthen the integrity of sustainable investments and address the escalating issue of ‘greenwashing’ in the financial sector.

item.title: Have gas firms undermined heat pumps?
item.description: ClientEarth lawyers believe that there may be evidence suggesting that certain parts of the gas industry joined together to influence the development of the UK home heating mark

item.title: Solar sales surge 54%
item.description: The conflict in the Middle East as seen a dramatic rise in the number of British households, with Octopus Energy, amongst others, seeing record‑breaking demand, with the company logging its biggest‑ever month for enquiries and sales.

item.title: Interest in EV leasing jumps 36%
item.description: Octopus Electric Vehicles (Octopus EV) has seen EV leasing enquiries rise by 36 per cent since the start of the conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: SSE’s Ferrybridge BESS fully operational
item.description: SSE’s Ferrybridge Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) in West Yorkshire is fully operational.
